snippet.title: Synth Riders® on Nintendo Switch | Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Ride the rhythm through a cyberpunk future

Become a Synth Rider in a futuristic musical world- Experience a high-octane Cyberpunk musical adventure where you catch notes, weave through obstacles, and ride neon rails in perfect sync with the beat.  Grab your hoverboard and perform epic air stunts in retro futuristic cityscapes!

Multiplayer Musical Mayhem: Up to FOUR PLAYERS can throw down in VERSUS or jump into a COUCH CO-OP mode where all players must work together and share the beat!  Whether you’re score chasing or rhythm riding as a group, all skill levels are welcome in Synth Riders Overdrive.

Broad library of music options: Up to 64 electrifying tracks,* from synthwave—the genre that inspired the game’s VR origins—to ’80s anthems and today’s hits. Starting with its synthwave roots, the soundtrack has expanded to feature songs from amazing artists including: 
- Wham!
- Queen
- David Guetta and OneRepublic
- Charli xcx
- Artemas
- Sia
- Jack Harlow
- Tokyo Machine
- Sunset Neon
- Starcadian
- Dance with the Dead
- The Midnight
- Jamie Berry
…and many more!

The party doesn’t stop: Crave more epic sessions? Explore DLC artist packs featuring Gorillaz, Monstercat artists and more – each bringing new beats and movements to take on!

The fate of the city is in your hands in Campaign mode! Rebels are racing against time to stop ruthless AI from seizing control in this adrenaline-fueled musical battleground. Can you defeat XANDER?

*Note that number of songs vary per Nintendo game: base game has 28 songs and Ultimate Edition has 64 songs.

Follow Synth Riders® Nintendo Switch on socials:
- @synthridersgg

Join the community & chat with the devs today!
